summary_en: Leoclan updated its approach to management focused on capital cost and stock price awareness, providing current analysis, evaluation, and improvement measures.
title_en: Update on Measures toward Realizing Management Conscious of Capital Cost and Stock Price
translation_en_brief: On November 13, 2026, Leoclan announced an update to its capital cost and stock price-conscious management approach. The disclosure provides revised analysis and evaluation of the company's current position, along with its framework for improvement initiatives moving forward. Specific details regarding target metrics, timelines, and implementation measures are contained in the attached materials.
